record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: For the SO(5)-symmetric D3-D7-brane defect conformal field theory, can one find a closed tree-level formula for one-point functions when the full scalar SO(6) sector is considered, beyond the already understood chiral-primary case?

evidence.quote: As regards the integrability properties of one-point functions an interesting question is whether a closed formula can be found even at tree-level for the closely related SO(5) symmetric D3-D7-brane based dCFT.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the defect conformal field theory obtained as the holographic dual of the SO(5)-symmetric D3–D7 probe-brane system with non-vanishing instanton number, in which a codimension-one defect breaks the bulk N=4 super Yang–Mills R-symmetry SO(6) to SO(5). On the gauge-theory side, single-trace scalar operators in the full SO(6) scalar sector are built from the six real scalars of N=4 SYM and, at one loop, are eigenstates of an integrable SO(6) spin chain. Their tree-level one-point functions in the presence of the defect are computed as overlaps of Bethe eigenstates of the SO(6) spin chain with a definite matrix-product state encoding the classical solution sourced by the D7 brane.

Problem: Determine whether there exists a closed-form tree-level expression (for instance, a determinant-type or factorized formula in terms of Bethe roots, magnon momenta, and the instanton number k) giving the one-point function of an arbitrary Bethe eigenstate of the full SO(6) scalar sector in this SO(5)-symmetric D3–D7 defect CFT, valid for any number of excitations and for general k, thereby extending the known closed-form result for chiral-primary (BPS) operators to all non-protected scalar operators.
artifact.status_search_result: Tree-level one-point functions in the SO(5)-symmetric D3–D7 dCFT have been computed for chiral primaries and, in the non-protected SO(6) scalar sector, only for operators with a small number of excitations, where closed expressions in terms of Bethe roots are available. The matrix product state has been shown to satisfy an integrability criterion, but a general closed-form expression for the overlap with arbitrary SO(6) Bethe eigenstates (unlike the D3–D5 case, where a determinant formula was obtained) has not been found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: One-Point Functions of Non-protected Operators in the SO(5) symmetric D3-D7 dCFT
status_evidence.snippet: Closed expressions in terms of Bethe roots are found for operators with a small number of excitations; a general closed formula has so far evaded discovery.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial closed-form results are known; the general problem in the SO(6) sector of the D3-D7 dCFT remains open.

status_evidence.title: Scalar one-point functions and matrix product states of AdS/dCFT
status_evidence.snippet: Matrix product state fulfills the integrability criterion; continued search for a closed expression for the overlap with Bethe eigenstates is important.
status_evidence.claim: No closed-form overlap formula is yet established for the D3-D7 case.
